Title: Add an allowlisted server-call gateway and client/server version handshake
Problem / Request: The saved PULSE-017 client can produce an opaque dynamic-call failure when a requested Apps Script function is unavailable or a stale browser client is paired with newer server code. Replace the unguarded dynamic dispatcher and make version mismatches recoverable and readable.
Acceptance Criteria: Every client-callable function is explicitly allowlisted; missing methods report the exact function name; boot performs a read-only runtime-capabilities and version handshake; stale clients receive a refresh/redeploy message instead of a generic TypeError; normal DEV writes and deterministic mode=test behavior remain unchanged; CI validates the call surface; no automatic deployment or production change.

builder.summary: Add an allowlisted server-call gateway and client/server version handshake

operations: Add a read-only server capability and version endpoint with an explicit inventory of every Runtime Lite client-callable function.
Mirror the runtime capability contract in deterministic mode=test without making an Apps Script call.
Replace the opaque dynamic property call with an explicit allowlisted gateway that names unsupported, failed, or unavailable server functions.
Perform a read-only boot handshake and fail closed with a readable refresh/redeploy message before any DEV write control can be used.

builder.usage: No AI used — exact operations staged in Task Patches
